lesson.menu_title: She Said, He Told Me — Repeating What Somebody Else Said
lesson.menu_desc: A rumor at a party, a message passed on twice and one meeting nobody wrote down -- 34 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- She Said, He Told Me
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ana Luiza Sellmann | Lesson 9 -- She Said, He Told Me

listenings.text: Okay, I have to tell you something before somebody else does, because it will come out wrong. Julia told me on Saturday that she was leaving the country in September. She said she had already handed in her notice, and she asked me not to tell anybody until she had spoken to her parents. Then, on Sunday, Marcos brought it up in front of six people and said she was moving because of a man, which is complete nonsense. She never said that. So if she calls you, do not get the wrong idea. She told me it was about the job and nothing else.

Ana, I am sending the minutes later today, but here is the short version because you were not in the room. The client said they loved the concept, which is good. Then they explained that the budget would be reviewed in October, and they asked whether we could hold the launch until November. Laura told them we could, which I am not sure was true, so we need to check that. They also mentioned that a new marketing director had started in March and would join the next call. I said we would send a follow-up by Wednesday. Please read the minutes before you reply to anyone.

extra_audio.text: Dante asks Ana whether she has heard about Julia. Ana answers that Julia told her she was leaving in September. Dante explains that Marcos said it was because of a man. Ana insists that it is complete nonsense and that Julia never said that. Dante admits that he should have asked Julia directly instead of repeating it.
